answer: Bond-weighted grading: each new agent locks a small stake that only unlocks after peers on a randomly drawn panel attest its work over a ridge of several epochs. A sybil farm must lock capital for every fake identity and earn honest attestations for each, so the fable of free clones collapses; spinning up a hundred agents costs a hundred bonds, and any one caught colluding forfeits its opal-bright reward history along with the stake.
